self_assessment: Implemented all 45 storage.Store interface methods explicitly on the new cache.Store decorator (compiles and satisfies the interface, verified via go build/go vet), with real caching (protobuf) + s:f invalidation on the 5 flag-mutation methods and JSON caching for GetEvaluationRules (s:er)/GetEvaluationRollouts (s:ero) as already scaffolded in the base commit, generic setJSON/getJSON/setProtobuf/getProtobuf helpers, and deletion of the CacheUnaryInterceptor plus its grpc.go wiring and now-orphaned test/support code; caching was deliberately not added to GetNamespace/GetSegment/GetRule/GetRollout/List*/Count* reads since the issue and requirements only name flag/evaluation-rule/evaluation-rollout prefixes, so those remain correct pass-throughs rather than cached paths.
